canonical_example.translation: I suppose she's late because of the traffic.

canonical_example.text: Para imaginar un plan tan complejo se requiere una mente igual de compleja.
canonical_example.translation: In order to think up such a complex plan you need an equally complex mind.

canonical_example.text: Habrán acabado ya, ¿no? - Me imagino que sí.
canonical_example.translation: They must have finished already, don't you think? - I suppose so.

canonical_example.text: ¡Cómo se iba a imaginar él que un día le tocaría la lotería!
canonical_example.translation: How could he have guessed that he'd win the lottery one day!

canonical_example.text: ¿Te lo puedes imaginar casado y con hijos?
canonical_example.translation: Can you imagine him married with children?

canonical_example.text: Intenta imaginarte por un momento esta ciudad sin tráfico. ¿A que no puedes?
canonical_example.translation: Try to picture this city without traffic for a moment. I bet you can't.

synonyms.context: to say what will happen or be

canonical_example.text: Solo deseo hacerte feliz.
canonical_example.translation: I just want to make you happy.

canonical_example.text: Los discursos del presidente dejan mucho que desear.
canonical_example.translation: The president's speeches leave a lot to be desired.

canonical_example.text: Les deseé muchos años de felicidad.
canonical_example.translation: I wished them many years of happiness.

canonical_example.text: "Te deseo", dijo el rompecorazones de la película.
canonical_example.translation: "I want you," said the heartbreaker in the movie.

canonical_example.text: El director desea hablar con usted.
canonical_example.translation: The director wishes to speak to you.

canonical_example.text: "¿Qué desea?", preguntó el mayordomo.
canonical_example.translation: "How can I help you?," asked the butler.

synonyms.context: to have a strong desire for
